OAuth token issuance/refresh mints a caller credential rather than moving provider data. Exposing it as a CLI command would emit a token-derived value, which this repository forbids outright. Source: https://developers.notion.com/reference/create-a-token

OAuth token introspection reports the caller credential's active status, scope and issue time. Its response is entirely token-derived, so it is never rendered. Source: https://developers.notion.com/reference/introspect-token
OAuth token revocation is credential lifecycle, not provider data, and is handled by pm credentials rather than a connector command. Source: https://developers.notion.com/reference/revoke-token
